title: Sunflower Astra Gold - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Ruffled Yellow Sunflower
description:
Stunning ruffled golden sunflowers for a vibrant summer display!




 KEY FEATURES


• Unique ruffled golden petals for a distinctive look


• Fast-growing and easy to cultivate


• Tall, branching habit perfect for borders and cutting


• Attracts pollinators and provides bird feed


• Excellent as cut flowers with long vase life




 PLANT DETAILS


Type: Vegetables — Helianthus annuus


Colour: Golden Yellow


Season: Mid Summer - Early Autumn


Growth Habit: Upright, branching


Flavour: Mild, nutty (for seeds)


Time to Harvest: 58 days (for seeds)




 GROWING CONDITIONS


Sun: Full sun


Soil: Moderately fertile, humus-rich, neutral to alkaline, moist, well-drained soil


Watering: Regularly when establishing, then deeply but infrequently once established


Spacing: 40-50cm (18 inches) apart


Height: 150-175cm (5-6ft)


Spread: 30cm (12 inches)


Hardiness: Hardy Annual




 CARE INSTRUCTIONS


• Plant out after the last risk of frost has passed, ensuring a sunny, sheltered spot.


• Protect young seedlings from slugs and snails, especially during early growth.


• Water regularly during dry spells, especially as plants establish.


• Provide support or stake taller plants if needed to prevent wind damage.


• For continuous blooms, consider succession planting every 2-3 weeks until the first frost.




 WHAT'S INCLUDED


2x Mini Plug Plants
